notifications_emergency_id_failed_at_idx.name: notifications_emergency_id_failed_at_idx
notifications_emergency_id_failed_at_idx.where: "notifications"."worksite_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL

work_items_verified_check.name: work_items_verified_check
work_items_verified_check.value: "work_items"."verified_by" IS NULL OR "work_items"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL

worksite_updates_cancelled_check.name: worksite_updates_cancelled_check
worksite_updates_cancelled_check.value: "worksite_updates"."cancelled_by" IS NULL OR "worksite_updates"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL

worksite_contacts_consent_check.name: worksite_contacts_consent_check
worksite_contacts_consent_check.value: ("worksite_contacts"."notify_channel" IS NULL AND "worksite_contacts"."notify_consent_at" IS NULL) OR ("worksite_contacts"."notify_channel" IN ('sms', 'whatsapp') AND "worksite_contacts"."notify_consent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "worksite_contacts"."phone" IS NOT NULL)

worksites_emergency_id_review_idx.name: worksites_emergency_id_review_idx
worksites_emergency_id_review_idx.where: "worksites"."location" IS NULL OR cardinality("worksites"."review_flags") > 0 OR (cardinality("worksites"."hazards") > 0 AND "worksites"."hazards_reviewed_at" IS NULL)

worksites_hazards_reviewed_check.name: worksites_hazards_reviewed_check
worksites_hazards_reviewed_check.value: "worksites"."hazards_reviewed_by" IS NULL OR "worksites"."hazards_reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
